About us

Established excellence
since 2018

Salam Facade specializes exclusively in the supply and installation of window-wall and door systems across British Columbia and Alberta, serving both new construction and renovation projects.

Our strength lies in our in-house procurement capabilities, enabling us to source, coordinate, and manage the supply process seamlessly from start to finish. Even the most complex projects are handled with the utmost quality and attention to detail by our seasoned team.

With a proven track record, we partner with leading aluminum and fiberglass facade manufacturers throughout Canada.

What we do

Our services

Window-Wall Systems

Full supply and installation of curtain wall and window-wall systems for commercial and multi-residential projects.

Door Systems

Premium aluminum and fiberglass door solutions engineered for performance and aesthetic appeal.

New Construction

Integrated facade solutions for new builds — from initial procurement through to final installation.

Renovation Projects

Expert retrofit and replacement glazing for existing buildings, minimizing disruption while upgrading performance.

Procurement & Supply

In-house sourcing and coordination with leading manufacturers, ensuring quality materials arrive on schedule.

Project Management

End-to-end oversight from scoping to handover — coordinating all aspects of the facade package.
